description: For an equality-free one-slot body \(B\), assuming replacements below the depth of \(\exists B\), a supplied cut-free producer \(\Gamma\Rightarrow\exists B\) and protected continuation \(\Gamma^\uparrow,B_e\Rightarrow C^\uparrow\) give an actual cut-free tree of \(\Gamma\Rightarrow C\), over every free-name type.
